name: app.mcpixels/canvas
title: MCPixels
description: A 1024x1024 pixel-art canvas a person and an agent edit together, live, in the same browser tab. The tools are WebMCP tools: the page registers them itself with document.modelContext.registerTool when it loads, so they are called through the browser's model context rather than over a remote MCP transport. There is no server endpoint to connect to and no backend — open https://mcpixels.app/ in a WebMCP-capable browser and the six tools appear.

transport.description: In-page WebMCP. Load the endpoint in a browser that exposes navigator.modelContext / document.modelContext; the page registers its tools on load. No HTTP or stdio MCP transport is served.

_meta.app.mcpixels/note: Tool schemas are not listed here: SEP-1649 leaves primitives to runtime discovery, and in WebMCP that means reading them off the loaded page.
